name: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!
summary: Rackmore's log tells of a ship bound for Feathermoon Stronghold that was set upon by creatures of the sea. To keep his treasure from his enemies, Rackmore hid the chest on Ranazjar Isle, and the silver key and golden key that open it are lost.

sections.title: A Hidden Chest
sections.body: The log says Rackmore's ship was on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold when seafaring creatures attacked it. Hoping to keep his treasure from his enemies, he hid the chest on Ranazjar Isle. Two keys open it, one silver and one gold, and both were lost. Someone who finds the keys and the chest will find a treasure.

faq.q: Where was Rackmore's ship sailing when it was attacked?
faq.answer: His log says his ship was on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold when seafaring creatures attacked.
On Ranazjar Isle, where Rackmore hid it.

faq.q: What is needed to unlock the chest?
faq.answer: Two keys, Rackmore's Silver Key and Rackmore's Golden Key. Both were lost.

faq.q: Why did Rackmore hide his treasure?
faq.answer: His ship came under attack, and he hid the chest on Ranazjar Isle so the treasure would not fall into enemy hands.
